test_title: PYST 46: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

The art of careful public speaking, using clear pronunciation
solution:
The correct answer is "**Elocution**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the word "elocution" can replace the given phrase.**
 
• **Elocution means the art of public speaking, especially in regards to clear pronunciation and expression.**(वक्तृत्व कला)
 
• It involves careful consideration of tone, pace, and emphasis to effectively convey a message.
 
• Elocution is often taught as a skill in schools and can be useful in many professional settings.
 
 
• Example: The actor's elocution was very impressive.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 - Incubation: This refers to the process of keeping something at a certain temperature or condition to allow it to develop or grow. It is not related to public speaking.(ऊष्मायन)
 
• Option 3 - Abdication: This means to renounce or give up a position of power or responsibility, usually voluntarily. It is also not related to public speaking.(त्याग)
 
• Option 4 - Obrution: This is not a commonly used word in English and does not have a clear definition. It is likely not the correct answer.(आपत्ति)

38:Td64,

योग्य उत्तर "**वक्तृत्व**" आहे.
